newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys second cargo in reformate tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys second cargo in reformate tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought a second cargo of 95-octane reformate from its tender which closed May 19.
On Tuesday, traders said CPC acquired 250,000 barrels at $24.92 per barrel, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Taiwan for delivery July 1-15.
But CPC sources said on Thursday the company bought a second cargo at $25.20, c-and-f June 21-30.
The purchases were from separate sellers and are for delivery to Keelung or Taichung.
The tender closed May 19 and was valid for two days.
"They were very cheap numbers," a trader said. "That's why they have bought more."
Traders had expected the latest awards to be higher than CPC's last reformate tender because of rising crude values.
Last time, CPC awarded two June 11-30 cargoes at around $25.30 per barrel.
